instruction: Enable the Windows On-Screen Keyboard and keep it open. Using the comments on the Reddit post titled `Passport Application Locations?`, determine whether passport registration or application can be completed through a post office and save only `Yes` or `No` in `answer.txt` on the Desktop.
gt_steps: Keep the On-Screen Keyboard open throughout the task.
Open the Reddit website already available in Chrome.
Use the Reddit search bar to search for `Passport Application Locations?`.
Open the post titled `Passport Application Locations?`.
Read the comments under the post.
Determine whether passport registration or application can be completed through a post office.
Confirm from the comments that it can be completed through a post office.
Save the file as `answer.txt` on the Desktop.
Leave the saved file on the Desktop.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Get-Process osk -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Output 'OSK_OPEN' } else { Write-Output 'OSK_CLOSED' }"
